parameters.name: X-MediFlow-Ordinary-Projection
parameters.description: Opaque host-owned one-use address. Header, function, MIME and ids never create source authority.

schema.description: DS only: decoded selected attachment bytes, 1..26214400 bytes. No JSON, source paths or parser settings.

post.description: Native paired session only. JSON UTF-8, duplicate keys denied; exact content-type required. DS uses the already-issued native AnyDoc locator and existing binary parser/OCR pipeline. Processing bound 120s, original source lifetime at most 300s; lock/logout/selection changes revoke synchronously. No keys, PINs, server decrypt, writes or automatic consent.

delete.description: Empty body. Idempotent absent grant; cannot cancel a different active attempt. Cleanup failure returns cleanupConfirmed=false and must block UI reuse. Revocation is performed even when the submitted empty-body contract is invalid.

NativePatientInsightInput.description: Selettore passivo. Le fonti sono acquisite e ricostruite esclusivamente dall’Application Service host; nessun testo o proiezione dal client.

result.description: Original function wire, unmodified: Patient Insight/Smart Import preview, Document Synthesis publication or Treatment Reasoning publication. Proposal-only; original parser, receipt and final owner commit remain mandatory.

NativeOrdinaryPreparation.description: Ingress esatto per functionId, massimo 4096 byte UTF-8; ulteriori vincoli runtime: stringhe ben formate, limiti UTF-16, soli oggetti ordinari enumerabili senza proxy/accessor/simboli. Nessuna autorità di sorgente dal DTO.
